cohort: The study included 62 multiparous pregnant women, with 31 assigned to receive Hugo point pressure and 31 to a control group without the intervention.
finding: Hugo point pressure significantly reduced pain intensity during the first two hours after delivery but showed no significant difference in pain intensity at 4, 6, and 8 hours, nor in pain duration or painkiller use compared to the control group.
followup_time: Up to 32 hours after delivery (measurements taken 2, 4, 6, and 8 hours after intervention, which was administered 2-24 hours post-delivery)
